data.title: Slow evenings on the banks of the Nile
data.subtitle: Thatched cottages with river views, an infinity pool, sunset boat cruises and unhurried Ugandan hospitality — about 90 minutes from Kampala.

data.heading: A lodge built for slow weekends

data.heading: Rooms, Cottages & Experiences
data.subheading: Every rate includes full breakfast, WiFi and pool access. Mix your stay with a cruise, a riverside dinner or a day on the rapids.

services.name: Deluxe Riverview Cottage
services.description: King-size bed, en-suite hot shower and a private wooden balcony looking straight over the Nile rapids.

services.name: Family Two-Bedroom Villa
services.description: Two bedrooms, a private lounge and a garden patio — comfortable space for four to five guests, steps from the pool.

services.name: Sunset Boat Cruise
services.description: A relaxed two-hour evening cruise with chilled drinks, birdwatching and the sun going down over the river.

services.name: Riverside Dining & Tilapia BBQ
services.description: Fresh Nile tilapia grilled on charcoal and served on the terrace as the lanterns come on in the evening.

services.name: Nile Adventures Desk
services.description: White-water rafting and quad biking with certified guides and full safety gear — booked for you at reception.

services.name: Weddings, Retreats & Conferences
services.description: A 60-seat hall, a garden lawn for weddings and team-building activities, with catering arranged for your group.

data.heading: The Lodge, Up Close
data.subheading: Pool afternoons, river evenings and slow mornings — a look at everyday life at the lodge.

data.heading: Weekend & Getaway Packages
data.subheading: Bundled stays for couples, families and teams — flexible dates, confirmed on enquiry.

data.heading: Guest Reviews
data.subheading: Couples, families and teams who stayed with us by the Nile.

testimonials.name: Joshua & Brenda O.
testimonials.text: We woke up to the sound of the rapids, had breakfast on the terrace and ended the day on the boat cruise. Everything felt easy and unhurried.

testimonials.name: Dr. Sarah A.
testimonials.text: The perfect place to rest between trips. Strong WiFi by the pool, quiet cottages and genuinely kind staff who remember your name.

testimonials.name: Ivan K.
testimonials.text: We hosted 25 staff here for two days. The hall worked perfectly, the BBQ night was a highlight, and the team kept talking about the cruise for weeks.

data.heading: Find Us on the Banks of the Nile
data.subheading: Ten minutes from Jinja town centre, along Kyabirwa Road — we share full directions when you book.

data.heading: Reserve Your Stay
data.subheading: Tell us your dates and number of guests — reservations replies within a few hours, any day of the week.
